# Marcrypt

> Local document encryption for legal professionals. Batch-encrypt, watermark,
> and Bates-number PDF, Word, and folder contents entirely on macOS. Marcrypt
> makes no network calls by design, so client data never leaves the machine.

Marcrypt ships a SwiftUI macOS app, a `MarcryptCLI` command-line interface, and
a `MarcryptCore` library shared by both. Cryptography comes from Apple
frameworks (CommonCrypto, CryptoKit, PDFKit) plus WinZip AES-256 for archives
and Microsoft Agile Encryption for DOCX.

Start at `docs/INDEX.md`. It carries one line per document with a scope
sentence, heading anchors, and the code globs each document describes.

## Docs

- [Docs index](docs/INDEX.md): The projection. One line per document; read this first and jump to the section you need.
- [Domain glossary](docs/CONTEXT.md): Marcrypt vocabulary — Bates numbering, Agile Encryption, shredding, audit trail, batch receipt.
- [Product requirements](docs/PRODUCT_REQUIREMENTS.md): Authoritative goals, core features, UI and technical requirements for 1.0.
- [Release notes 1.0.0-beta](docs/RELEASE_NOTES_v1.0.0-beta.md): User-facing highlights, install steps, and known limitations.
